item.text: The constructor already checks for missing values, but the env names are private constants and the tests only set them conditionally, so ambient process values can mask missing-variable cases. I’m exporting the two requested names, using them for all corresponding reads, and making the test environment explicit—including validation of the returned error and loaded config.
